metadata.description: FitNMove helps you train smarter, move daily, track progress, and compete with momentum in one mobile-first fitness hub.

hero.subtitle: Train with structure, move with purpose, and compete through points, ranks, and daily wins.

philosophy.desc1: FitNMove is more than a tracking tool —
philosophy.desc2: it's a training, movement, and competition hub that helps your daily effort add up.

features.desc01: Plan workouts, follow sets, and use feedback to make every session clearer.
features.desc02: Walks, runs, exercise, sleep, weight, water, and nutrition live together so progress is easier to read.
features.desc03: Weight trends, nutrition intake, sleep quality, exercise performance — all at a glance. Make better decisions with an integrated perspective.
features.desc04: Daily tasks, ranks, points, medals, and leaderboards turn consistency into something worth chasing.

install.ios02: Tap the share button at the bottom
install.android02: Tap the menu button ⋮ at the top right

blog.title: FitNMove Knowledge Base
blog.subtitle: In-depth content on nutrition science, training methods, and sleep optimization.
